title: partner sync timeout fixed by sandbox endpoint
l0: pnpm sync:partner timed out during the partner API handshake.
l1: Set PAYMENT_GATEWAY_URL= to the sandbox endpoint before rerunning partner sync in CI.

title: partner sync timeout fixed by CA bundle refresh
l0: pnpm sync:partner timed out after TLS negotiation against the same partner API.
l1: Keep PAYMENT_GATEWAY_URL= unchanged; refresh PARTNER_CA_BUNDLE before rerunning when the timeout follows TLS renegotiation.

title: partner sync 401 fixed by token rotation
l0: pnpm sync:partner returned a 401 after credentials expired.
l1: Rotate PARTNER_SYNC_TOKEN before rerunning the same sync command.

title: storybook static build fixed by font preload
l0: storybook build failed because font assets were not preloaded.
l1: Add the Inter font preload before running storybook build in CI.
